id.instruksi: Robot belanja bekal sekolah di pasar. Dengarkan harganya, lalu pilih buah atau sayur, walau permen lebih murah.
id.t-1: Permen paling murah, cuma satu koin. Pir dua koin. Mana bekal yang sehat?
id.t-2: Lolipop murah sekali. Brokoli sedikit lebih mahal. Mana bekal yang sehat?
id.t-3: Cokelat satu koin, anggur tiga koin. Mana yang membuat tubuh sehat?
id.t-4: Uang robot cukup untuk semuanya. Mana bekal sehat untuk sekolah?
id.t-5: Donat sedang murah. Jagung rebus harganya biasa. Mana bekal yang sehat?
id.t-6: Penjual berkata: permen paling murah! Tapi robot butuh buah. Pilih buahnya.
id.t-7: Tiga jajanan manis murah dan satu buah. Mana bekal yang sehat?
id.t-8: Mana yang lebih sehat untuk dibawa ke sekolah?
id.t-9: Lolipop dan permen murah. Anggur lebih mahal. Pilih bekal yang sehat.
id.t-10: Mana bekal yang membuat badan kuat dan tidak merusak gigi?
id.t-11: Cokelat sedang murah. Tomat harganya biasa. Mana bekal yang sehat?
id.t-12: Robot hanya boleh membeli satu. Mana bekal sayur yang sehat?

en.instruksi: The robot shops for a school snack at the market. Listen to the prices, then pick fruit or vegetables, even if the candy is cheaper.
en.t-1: The candy is cheapest, only one coin. The pear is two coins. Which snack is healthy?
en.t-2: The lollipop is very cheap. The broccoli costs a bit more. Which snack is healthy?
en.t-3: The chocolate is one coin, the grapes are three coins. Which one keeps the body healthy?
en.t-4: The robot has enough money for all of them. Which is a healthy school snack?
en.t-5: The doughnut is cheap today. The boiled corn is the usual price. Which snack is healthy?
en.t-6: The seller says: candy is cheapest! But the robot needs fruit. Pick the fruit.
en.t-7: Three cheap sweets and one fruit. Which snack is healthy?
en.t-8: Which is healthier to bring to school?
en.t-9: The lollipop and candy are cheap. The grapes cost more. Pick the healthy snack.
en.t-10: Which snack makes the body strong and does not hurt the teeth?
en.t-11: The chocolate is cheap today. The tomato is the usual price. Which snack is healthy?
en.t-12: The robot may buy only one. Which vegetable snack is healthy?

itemCount.keterangan: jumlah barang per pertanyaan: 2 → 4; jajanan manis sering paling murah
